A.subscription_fee: USD 84,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance

measurement.method: automated checks every minute from 3 locations; Downtime is 5 or more consecutive minutes; (total minutes - Downtime) / (total minutes - excluded minutes), rounded to two decimals

A.claim_deadline: 30 days after the end of the Measurement Period
A.credit_payment: applied against next invoice; if no further invoice is due, paid within 30 days after claim is agreed

other.chronic_failure: below 99.0% in 3 of any 6 consecutive periods allows termination on 30 days' notice, given within 30 days

B.subscription_fee: USD 36,000 per year, invoiced quarterly in advance

measurement.method: automated checks every minute from 2 locations; Downtime is 5 or more consecutive minutes; (total minutes - Downtime) / (total minutes - excluded minutes), rounded to two decimals

B.claim_deadline: 45 days after the end of the Measurement Period
B.credit_payment: applied against next invoice; if no further invoice is due, paid within 45 days after claim is agreed

other.chronic_failure: below 98.0% in 2 of any 4 consecutive periods allows termination on 30 days' notice, given within 30 days
